invariant_bindings.invariant_text: evaluate() MUST NEVER echo back an Origin that is not in the configured allowlist.
When allow_credentials is True, allow_origin CANNOT be '*' and MUST be a single exact origin.
Vary: Origin MUST be emitted on any response that decides per-origin, or the policy SHALL reject evaluation.
Preflight caching (Access-Control-Max-Age) MUST be <=86400 seconds and MUST NEVER default to unbounded.
Null origin ('null') MUST be rejected in credentialed mode because it collapses distinct sandboxed contexts.
